title: Re-Asks with Repair Tool Call
body:
### Feature Description

Support "re-asks" with experimental repair tool call. An implementation of re-ask would be to return a tool call result, but with the error (no tool exists, args doesn't match input schema) message attached. https://x.com/lgrammel/status/1865067908214255978

Based on the current implementation, it doesn't seem like it's possible to return a generic object (like in a tool call result), only an actual tool call object: https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/main/packages/ai/core/generate-text/parse-tool-call.ts


### Use Cases

Instead of throwing an error, generateText or streamText would "consume" a maxStep and try again with the message attached.

### Additional context

It might be worth deferring input schema validation until the execute method. This is to let parallel tool calls that don't have an error proceed.

Right now for [`generateText`](https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/e7a9ec9e916b7cc49e3296d7644be62f9949263c/packages/ai/core/generate-text/generate-text.ts#L385-L408), it's written as

```
toolCalls = toolCalls.map(parseToolCalls)
toolResults = toolCalls.map(executeToolCalls)
```

but maybe it should be

```
toolResults = toolCalls.map(executeToolCalls(parseToolCalls))
```

Instead of throwing an error in `doParseToolCall`, we can set a boolean like `mismatchedArgs`. If the toolName doesn't exist, we could define a wild card fall back tool that developers could provide custom execute method for.

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/main/packages/ai/core/generate-text/parse-tool-call.ts
